name: Voronoi Chaos
description: Agitated cellular refraction: F1/F2 seam tracking turns each Voronoi cell into a bevelled glass facet whose border normal refracts and chromatically splits the image, and every cell is assigned one of the eight FFT bins so the mosaic breaks up frequency by frequency. Held pointer strengthens repulsion; clicks send bounded shatter fronts. Seam energy persists through dataTextureC.

updatedParams.name: Chaos Amount
updatedParams.description: Pointer repulsion and jitter gain; bass, hold and click fronts add on top.

updatedParams.name: Color Mix
updatedParams.description: Blend between the refracted image sample and the per-cell ID tint.

updatedParams.name: Center Dot Size
updatedParams.description: Radius of the dark marker at each cell centre.
